pattern.name: hexagonal
pattern.description: Ports and Adapters. Domain logic has ZERO knowledge of any external technology. External dependencies are declared as TypeScript interfaces (ports) in src/_shared/ports/. Concrete implementations (adapters) live in supabase/functions/_shared/adapters/. Effect Layers provide adapters to the domain at runtime.
pattern.rule: Never import a Supabase, Gemini, or Expo SDK inside src/_shared/domain/.
Never import an adapter directly in a service. Request the port via Effect.service().

pattern.name: tactical-ddd
pattern.description: Value Objects, Domain Services, Factories, and Specifications in src/_shared/domain/. No Aggregates, no Domain Events in v1. Pure TypeScript — no React, no Deno, no runtime deps.
pattern.rule: Business rules (e.g. "depleted quantity triggers full-use") live in Domain Services, not in hooks, queries, or handlers.
Value Objects are immutable. Never mutate a Value Object; return a new one.

pattern.name: effect
pattern.description: Effect (@effect/effect) is used exclusively in: 1. Supabase Edge Functions (supabase/functions/) 2. src/_shared/domain/ (typed errors, pure Effect computations) NOT on the React Native client — no Effect runtime in the Expo bundle.
pattern.rule: Every Edge Function service function returns Effect.Effect<A, E, R> with explicit type parameters.
Never use try/catch to handle Effect errors. Use Effect.catchTag, Effect.catchAll, or Effect.match.
Every port interface method returns an Effect, not a Promise.
Use Effect.service(PortTag) to request dependencies. Never instantiate an adapter directly inside a service.
Retry policy for external API calls: Effect.retry(Schedule.exponential("200 millis").pipe(Schedule.upTo(3))).
Use Effect.Stream for The Haul parallel processing (max concurrency: 5).
Use Effect.Scope for temp file lifecycle management in the upload pipeline.

pattern.name: xstate
pattern.description: XState v5 (actor model) is used ONLY for the item lifecycle state machine. Zustand handles all other state (auth, kitchen, upload, settings).
pattern.rule: Do not use XState for auth flow, upload pipeline state, or settings. Use Zustand stores for those.
Spawn the item actor inside useItemActor(itemId) hook. Do not store XState actors in Zustand.
XState guards validate transitions. Illegal transitions must not silently fail — throw a typed error.

pattern.name: cqrs-convention
pattern.description: Lightweight CQRS by naming convention only. No command bus. Commands live in *.service.ts. Queries live in *.query.ts.
pattern.rule: Functions that mutate state are Commands: AddItemCommand, MarkItemUsedCommand, InviteUserCommand.
Functions that only read state are Queries: GetStashQuery, GetDashboardAggregates.
Never put a mutation inside a *.query.ts file.
Never put a SELECT-only operation inside a *.service.ts file that is designated for commands.

pattern.name: expo-router-thin-shells
pattern.description: app/ contains Expo Router route files only. Every route file is a thin shell: it imports one screen component and re-exports it as default. Maximum 8 lines per app/ file. No logic, no hooks, no stores.
pattern.rule: app/ files may only import from src/features/.
Route params are extracted in the app/ file and passed as props to the screen component.

rules.rule: domain is kebab-case. Can be compound: kitchen-members, item-card, expiry-date, analyse-image.
subtype is optional. Used in: (a) test files to identify what is being tested; (b) disambiguation when a pod has multiple files of the same type.
type must be exactly one value from the Type Vocabulary section. No invented types.
extension is .tsx for files containing JSX; .ts for everything else.
All segments are kebab-case. No camelCase or PascalCase in file names.
Test files: .test is always the final segment before the extension. Example: kitchen.hook.test.ts
index.ts is reserved exclusively for public API barrels. Never use index as a domain name.
.spec suffix means Specification Pattern predicate. It is NOT a Vitest test file. Use .test for Vitest tests.
Prefer compound domain names (kitchen-members.component.tsx) over subtype disambiguation (kitchen.members.component.tsx) for source files. Reserve subtype for test files and edge cases.

type.name: screen
type.description: Full-screen stateful container. Backed by an Expo Router route. Reads TanStack Query + Zustand. Triggers mutations. Lives in a feature pod.

type.name: component
type.description: Reusable presenter. Pure props — no Supabase, no Zustand, no side effects. Trivially testable.

type.name: hook
type.description: Custom React hook. Encapsulates side effects, subscriptions, mutation calls. May read Zustand and TanStack Query.

type.name: store
type.description: Zustand store slice. Exported as a hook (useAuthStore). One slice per pod.

type.name: query
type.description: TanStack Query definitions for one domain: useQuery, useInfiniteQuery, useMutation wrappers. Handles optimistic updates (onMutate/onError/onSettled).

type.name: machine
type.description: XState v5 state machine. Scoped to item lifecycle only in v1.

type.name: schema
type.description: Zod v4 schema definitions and their inferred TypeScript types. DB rows, insert/update shapes, form validation, Edge Function I/O contracts.

type.name: type
type.description: TypeScript types and interfaces that do not need runtime validation. Structural types, union types, mapped types.

type.name: util
type.description: Pure functions. No side effects. No React. No infrastructure. Importable from both client and Deno.

type.name: constant
type.description: export const values only. Static lists, magic numbers, configuration. No functions.

type.name: handler
type.description: Deno Edge Function entry point. Parses HTTP request, runs middleware pipeline, executes Effect program, returns HTTP response. Maximum 40 lines.

type.name: service
type.description: Business orchestration logic. Coordinates domain objects, ports, and external calls. Returns Effect. Used in both Edge Functions and domain layer.

type.name: adapter
type.description: Concrete hexagonal adapter. Implements a port interface using a real external technology. Lives in supabase/functions/_shared/adapters/.

type.name: port
type.description: Hexagonal port. TypeScript interface only — zero implementation code. Lives in src/_shared/ports/.

type.name: error
type.description: Typed error classes for Effect's error channel. Each has a _tag discriminant for exhaustive matching.

type.name: value-object
type.description: Tactical DDD Value Object. Immutable. Defined by value not identity. Encapsulates business rules about a concept.

type.name: factory
type.description: Creates domain objects from multiple possible input shapes. Centralises mapping logic.

type.name: spec
type.description: Specification Pattern predicate. Composable business rule. NOT a test file.

type.name: test
type.description: Vitest test file. Always the final segment before the file extension. Use .tsx if the test renders JSX. Colocated with the source file.

routing-layer.rule: Thin shells only. Every file is max 8 lines.
May only import from src/features/ and expo-router.
No hooks, no stores, no Supabase calls.

pod.name: auth
pod.owns: Auth flows, session management, account deletion, OAuth upgrade

pod.name: kitchen
pod.owns: Kitchen CRUD, members list, invite generation, role management

pod.name: item
pod.owns: Item domain, XState machine, The Label screen, ItemCard component, QuantityModal

pod.name: stash
pod.owns: The Stash list view, filter chips, swipe actions

pod.name: scan
pod.owns: Camera, Snap It, The Haul, Check It, Line Em Up, barcode scanning, upload pipeline

pod.name: dashboard
pod.owns: The Fridge Door, fun fact card, urgency grid, category chart, finished strip

pod.name: settings
pod.owns: House Rules screen, Heads Up (notification prefs), settingsStore

feature-pods.rule: Each pod exposes a public API via index.ts. Import only from the pod's index.ts, never from internal pod files.
Every pod may have: screen(s), component(s), hook, store, query, schema, type, util, constant, machine (item only). Only create files that are needed.

sublayer.contains: Pure business logic — Value Objects, Domain Services, Factories, Specifications. Zero runtime deps.
Hexagonal port interfaces (TypeScript interfaces only). No implementation code.
Typed error classes with _tag discriminants for Effect's error channel.
Zod v4 schemas and inferred TypeScript types used across pods and Edge Functions.

shared-layer.rule: Nothing in src/_shared/ may import React, Supabase, Gemini SDK, Expo SDK, or any infrastructure library.
src/_shared/ is importable from both src/features/ (React Native) and supabase/functions/ (Deno).

file.contains: Supabase JS client singleton, Realtime setup
TanStack Query client, AsyncStorage persister for offline reads
Expo push token registration and management

client-infra.rule: src/lib/ must not import from src/features/.

sublayer.contains: Concrete adapter implementations for all ports
Effect Layer compositions per external service

file.contains: Common Edge Function bootstrap (CORS, error formatting)

edge-functions.rule: handler.ts is the entry point only. Orchestration logic belongs in service.ts.

e2e-tests.rule: Maestro flow files are NOT colocated with feature pods. They live in e2e/flows/.
E2E file names: kebab-case descriptive name + .yaml. Example: snap-it-happy-path.yaml

imports.dependency-direction: app/ → src/features/ → src/_shared/ → (external packages only) supabase/functions/<fn>/ → supabase/functions/_shared/ → src/_shared/ → (external Deno packages)

from.to: src/_shared/, src/lib/, src/constants/, other pods via their index.ts

forbidden.rule: src/_shared/domain/ must not import React, Supabase, Gemini, Expo, or any infrastructure library.
app/ must not import from src/_shared/, src/lib/, or supabase/.
supabase/functions/ must not import from src/features/.
src/lib/ must not import from src/features/.
Cross-pod imports must use the pod's index.ts barrel, never internal files.
src/_shared/ports/ must contain interfaces only — no implementation or class instantiation.

imports.cross-pod-import-pattern:
import { ItemCard } from '@/features/item'
import { ItemCard } from '@/features/item/item-card.component'

api-reference.item: z.iso.datetime() — for TIMESTAMPTZ columns from Supabase (ISO 8601 with timezone)
z.url() — for Supabase Storage signed URLs
z.enum([...]) — for PostgreSQL CHECK IN constraints
.default(value) — on insert schemas to mirror DB defaults

omit.reason: Security: kitchen_invites.expires_at always set to NOW()+7days server-side
Populated by process-image Edge Function post-upload
Populated by process-image Edge Function post-upload

file.contains: Request/Response schemas for all 6 Edge Functions
Re-exports all public schemas and types

zustand.rule: Stores are accessed via their exported hook (useAuthStore, useKitchenStore, etc.).
uploadStore is in-memory only — never persisted.
Components (.component.tsx files) must not read Zustand stores. Read stores in screen files or hooks, pass as props.

tanstack-query.rule: Every useMutation must implement all three callbacks: onMutate (optimistic), onError (rollback + toast), onSettled (refetch).
The Stash and The Bin use useInfiniteQuery for cursor pagination. Never use a flat useQuery for paginated lists.
Configure gcTime: Infinity on Stash and Dashboard queries for offline reads (NFR-004).
TanStack Query client is initialised with AsyncStorage persister in src/lib/query-client.ts.
Invalidate queries on Supabase Realtime events inside useKitchenRealtime() hook.
Query keys follow the pattern: ['entity', 'operation', ...params]. Example: ['items', 'stash', kitchenId, filters].

response.means: Success — body matches the function's ResponseSchema
Unexpected defect — log and return generic message

edge-functions.rule: handler.ts maximum 40 lines. If it exceeds this, move logic to service.ts.
handler.ts must not contain business logic. It parses, pipelines, and responds.
service.ts must not construct HTTP responses. It returns Effect values.
All handler errors must be handled via Effect.match or Effect.catchAll before building the Response object.
The Gemini API key is read from Deno.env.get('GEMINI_API_KEY') inside the adapter only. Never in a handler or service.
The service role key is read from Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY') inside the Supabase adapter only.

error.fields: role: KitchenRole, requiredRole: KitchenRole, action: string
limit: number, current: number, resetDate: string
provider: string, message: string, retryable: boolean
operation: string, path: string, message: string

errors.rule: Every error class has a _tag: string field with a unique string literal value.
Use Effect.catchTag('NotFoundError', handler) — never catch by class instanceof.
Never use generic Error or unknown in an Effect's E type parameter.

item-taxonomy.tags: Dairy, Produce, Meat, Seafood, Bakery, Pantry, Frozen, Condiments, Beverages, Snacks, Leftovers, Herbs & Spices, Deli, Plant-Based
item-taxonomy.rule: These are the ONLY valid item tags. Defined in ItemTagSchema in src/_shared/types/item.schema.ts.
src/constants/tags.ts derives the array from ItemTagSchema.options — it never defines its own list.
The Check It form's tag chip selector reads from ITEM_TAGS constant, which comes from ItemTagSchema.options.

colocation.rule: Unit, component, and integration tests are colocated with the source file they test. Same directory.
Maestro E2E tests are NOT colocated. They live in e2e/flows/.
A pod contains only the files it needs. Do not create empty placeholder files.
A test file's name is always the source filename + .test: item.hook.ts → item.hook.test.ts
Component test files use .test.tsx if the test renders JSX; .test.ts otherwise.

anti-pattern.name: Logic in app/ route files
anti-pattern.description: app/ files must be thin shells. Any hook, state, or logic in an app/ file.
anti-pattern.fix: Move to the corresponding src/features/<pod>/ screen component.

anti-pattern.name: Supabase client in a component file
anti-pattern.description: Any import of supabase.ts or @supabase/supabase-js inside a *.component.tsx file.
anti-pattern.fix: Move the data call to a hook. Pass result as a prop to the component.

anti-pattern.name: Infrastructure import in src/_shared/domain/
anti-pattern.description: Any import of React, Supabase, Gemini SDK, Expo, or any package with side effects.
anti-pattern.fix: Domain layer is pure TypeScript. Call ports (interfaces) instead.

anti-pattern.name: Direct internal pod import
anti-pattern.description: import { X } from '@/features/item/item-card.component' from outside the item pod.

anti-pattern.name: try/catch on Effect
anti-pattern.description: Using try/catch to handle errors from an Effect computation.

anti-pattern.name: Business rule in query.ts
anti-pattern.description: Inline business logic (e.g. "if quantity <= 0, set status to used") inside a useMutation function body.
anti-pattern.fix: Call ItemLifecycleService.markUsed() from the mutation function. Keep logic in the domain service.

anti-pattern.name: Business logic in handler.ts
anti-pattern.description: Orchestration, domain rules, or external API calls directly in a .handler.ts file.
anti-pattern.fix: Move to <fn>.service.ts. The handler only parses, pipelines, and responds.

anti-pattern.name: Zustand read in a presenter component
anti-pattern.description: Any useXxxStore() call inside a *.component.tsx file.
anti-pattern.fix: Read the store in the parent screen or a hook. Pass the value as a prop.

anti-pattern.name: Invented file type not in vocabulary
anti-pattern.description: A file with a suffix not in the Type Vocabulary (e.g. *.controller.ts, *.repository.ts, *.context.ts).
anti-pattern.fix: Use the closest vocabulary type. Update the PRD first if a new type is genuinely needed.

anti-pattern.name: .spec.ts used as a Vitest test file
anti-pattern.description: A Vitest test file named *.spec.ts or *.spec.tsx.
anti-pattern.fix: Rename to *.test.ts / *.test.tsx. Reserve .spec for the Specification Pattern.

anti-pattern.name: XState for non-item state
anti-pattern.description: XState machine for auth flow, upload pipeline, or settings.
anti-pattern.fix: Use the appropriate Zustand store (authStore, uploadStore, settingsStore).

anti-pattern.name: index.ts used for implementation
anti-pattern.description: A pod's index.ts contains component, hook, or service implementation code.
anti-pattern.fix: index.ts is a barrel only. Move implementation to a named file.

anti-pattern.name: camelCase or PascalCase file names
anti-pattern.fix: item-card.component.tsx — all file names are kebab-case.

anti-pattern.name: Missing optimistic update in useMutation
anti-pattern.description: A useMutation that does not implement onMutate, onError, and onSettled.
anti-pattern.fix: All four mutations (mark used, mark wasted, add item, delete item) must implement all three callbacks.

anti-pattern.name: Secret in client code
anti-pattern.description: GEMINI_API_KEY or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY referenced outside of supabase/functions/.
anti-pattern.fix: Secrets live in Supabase Vault. Read only inside adapters via Deno.env.get().
